references.text: Jesus also speaks here about how difficult it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God, which is similar to what he says in Mark.
Similar to Jesus' words in Mark about the difficulties the rich face in entering the kingdom of God.
Encourages being free from love of money, which resonates with Jesus' warning in Mark about the challenges faced by the rich.
Speaks of the way of wisdom as better than wealth, which can be seen in light of Jesus' words about the difficulties the rich face in entering the kingdom of God.
